scope: Two Home shortcut cards only: Dhikr and Qibla

prompts.dhikr: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: compact 3D object illustration for a forest-green Islamic mobile app's Home shortcut card. Create an original, restrained emoji-like object render: clean readable silhouette, simple believable geometry, matte surfaces, very little ornament, crisp edges, no busy diorama. Soft broad studio lighting from upper left, gentle grounding shadow only. Three-quarter front view with mild top-down angle, centered square composition, entire object visible, generous 12% transparent padding. App colors: deep forest green #164D3B, muted olive green, warm ivory #F5F0E6, restrained antique gold #CFA750. Truly transparent background, no opaque tile, no backdrop, no glow, no decorative sparkles. No people, no writing, no pseudo-Arabic, no letters, no numbers, no watermark. Designed to remain recognizable at 64–120 px. Subject: one simple strand of round olive-green prayer beads, arranged in a clear loose oval resting on a small neatly folded warm-ivory prayer cloth with a narrow plain olive border. One modest antique-gold tassel drapes toward the front. Beads have individually defined round forms and a continuous plausible cord. The cloth is merely a low supporting folded square, not a book and not a miniature scene. Quiet tactile ceramic/wood-like finish, not glossy jewels. Similar directness and compact shape to a well-designed mobile tasbih emoji.
